title: Canonical discrete Galois action functor on geometric stalks
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in $\mathrm{Type}\,u$, with compatible algebra structures $K\to K_s\to\Omega$, $K_s$ a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure], and $\Omega$ algebraically closed. Let $J$ be the small etale topology on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let $p$ be the point defined by $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}K$, and let $p^*$ be its set-valued geometric stalk functor [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Put $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$ with the Krull topology and $w=\max(u+1,v)$. Let $U$ be the forgetful functor from discrete continuous $G$-sets in $\mathrm{Type}\,w$ to sets. There exist a functor $T:\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathrm{Type}\,w)\to\operatorname{DiscreteContAction}(\mathrm{Type}\,w,G)$ and a natural isomorphism $j:T\circ U\cong p^*$ satisfying the following canonical germ formula: for a sheaf $F$, $g\in G$, a $K$-automorphism $\tau$ of $\Omega$ with $\tau\circ i=i\circ g$ for the embedding $i:K_s\to\Omega$, an etale $K$-scheme $X$, lifts $x,x^{\prime}:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ over $K$ with $x^{\prime}=x\circ\operatorname{Spec}\tau$, and $z\in F(X)$, $j_F(g\cdot j_F^{-1}(\operatorname{germ}_x z))=\operatorname{germ}_{x^{\prime}}z$. This asserts only existence of the lifted functor and its action formula, not an equivalence.

proof.text: Extend each g to Omega (extend to the algebraic closure of K inside Omega, fix a transcendence basis, and extend to its algebraic closure). Change the pointed lift in a germ representative by precomposition with Spec of this extension. The finite separable residue field of the pointed neighbourhood lies in the image of Ks, so extensions giving the same g give identical lifts. The stalk colimit relations commute with change of lift, hence the action is well defined.

Spec is contravariant, so composition of lift changes gives a left action. Every representative is fixed by the subgroup fixing its finite separable residue-field image, an open subgroup for the Krull topology; this gives a discrete continuous action. Sheaf morphisms apply to the section and commute with lift changes. Thus stalk objects and maps define T, with j induced by their unchanged underlying sets and maps. Its formula follows on representatives.
